message.text: For task-mastermind-feedback-council: when the merged page lands, list each miss in one line: the ask, what was delivered, and which agent or skill produced it. mastermind-servex-2 fixes the skills that failed.

**Feedback council landed.** 44 asks, 5 checkers: 19 done · 24 partly · 1 not done · 6 in dispute.

[Verdict page](/framework/ai/2026-09-25/feedback-council/) (disagreements first) · small fixes are in [todo.md](/framework/ai/todo.md) section 1.

Worth a look: the Live card cold load is 1.7 to 4.6 s (the click is fast); the Landed list prints `[object Object]`; `ask_module` does not exist.

Most "partly" rows were built but never proven against your sentence. From now on, every landing report lists your asks as a checklist, ticked only with proof beside it, and the clarity agent fails any tick without proof.

The system review is ready to run: four cold Sonnet agents, each with one angle, then a comparison with how the system really works. It's in the brief at /framework/ai/2026-09-25/servex-mastermind/ (system-review/brief.md). I'm handing it to a fresh session, because mine is too full to judge it well.
